title: Design brief - Basic Health Unit Chak 45
summary: Single-storey RCC Basic Health Unit for the District Health Authority, Sahiwal: OPD and dispensary, mother and child health room, vaccination room with cold chain, laboratory, toilets, verandah and a doctor's residence.

format.lbo: Punjab Primary and Secondary Healthcare standard BHU design
format.energy: Building Code of Pakistan, Energy Provisions 2011

requirements.source_ref: Building Code of Pakistan, Seismic Provisions 2007

requirements.attribute: Hand pump or motor with overhead tank

programme.label: Covered area including the doctor's residence

topics.site_analysis: Site on Chak 45 Road given by the union council, above the flood line of the minor canal.
topics.supply: MEPCO connection with a 10 kW solar system and batteries for the cold chain, bore with motor and overhead tank.
topics.building_structure: RCC frame with brick infill, RCC roof slab with insulation and brick tile.
topics.construction_method: Item rate contract with Sahiwal Builders, concrete mixed on site under supervision.
topics.commissioning_sequence: Solar and cold chain tested by the EPI district team before the vaccination room opens.

studies.title: Site and flood level, Chak 45
studies.scope: Levels against the minor canal and the 2014 flood mark.
studies.author: Engr. Waqas Ahmed and Partners
studies.result: Plinth set 2 ft above the 2014 flood mark. Earth filling of about 300 m3 is needed.

issue_note: Design brief per the approved scheme, issued for construction.
